Difficulty not run: the submission did not pass every blocking quality or quality panel check. Oracle/NOP already passed. No Opus, GPT, analysis, or rubric-generation runs were started.

QUALITY PANEL: NEEDS REVISION -- 1 blocking issue to fix. Details for each are below.

Blocking (fix every one):
   1. [Sound Verifier] MAJOR: The growth tests do not distinguish an exact 110% eligibility
      comparison from a threshold prematurely truncated to whole cents.

Checked and clean: Coherent Contract, Correct Reference Solution, Protected Ground Truth,
  Deterministic Execution.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DETAILS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. [Sound Verifier] MAJOR -- missing behavioral coverage
   The growth tests do not distinguish an exact 110% eligibility comparison from a threshold
   prematurely truncated to whole cents.
   Why this fails:
     Reach: Use tiers [{"from":0,"bp":0}] and one account A for 2027-Q1, prior 251, purchases
     [["2027-01-15",1,276]], and empty returns, notices and sales. This is within section 1.
     Purchases and net are 276. Rule 4.1 requires net >= 276.1, so growth, total and carried
     must all be 0.
     Flip: Take an otherwise correct repair and implement eligibility as `prior > 0 and net >=
     prior * 110 // 100`, retaining correct half-up rounding of `(net-prior)*200/10000`. Integer
     division makes the threshold 276, so the account incorrectly qualifies. The increase is 25
     cents and its 200-basis-point share is exactly half a cent, rounded to 1; growth, total and
     carried become 1. This is an ordinary premature-rounding error, not a verifier-specific
     exploit.
     Static trace through the graded fixtures: the dedicated growth_110 accounts have
     (prior,net) values (100000,110000), (1000000,1100000), (100000,109900), and
     (100000,111225). Their thresholds are integral, and both implementations make identical
     decisions; the last account's bonus-rounding check also remains satisfied. All other shown
     positive-prior accounts are outside the sub-cent interval between the truncated and exact
     eligibility thresholds, so their decisions likewise remain unchanged. Prior-zero accounts
     still take the unchanged zero-prior guard. Thus every statement value remains unchanged on
     the rostered jobs. Relabelling changes only codes and ordering, and the expanded limits job
     has prior 100000000000 and net 2000000000000, safely above either threshold. The
     differential checks concern purchases, protection and chargebacks, none affected by this
     mutation. Leaving the driver unchanged also clears its byte checks. The verifier therefore
     accepts this plausible wrong implementation while its full comparator would reject the
     distinguishing job above.
   Where to look: environment/app/docs/rebate-schedule.md:102-105,
     environment/app/docs/rebate-schedule.md:11-14, tests/expected/growth_110.jsonl:1,
     tests/expected/growth_increase.jsonl:1-3, tests/expected/growth_no_prior.jsonl:1,
     tests/expected/limits_job.jsonl:1 (+2 more)
